description: U.S. Census Bureau Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services, July 2023 (Release CB23-127)
release_timestamp_source: Stated on the release itself: 'FOR RELEASE AT 8:30 AM EDT, TUESDAY, AUGUST 15, 2023' (data/raw/census_adv2307.pdf, page 1)
decision_cutoff_rationale: 90 minutes after the release: enough for the release and same-morning company disclosures to be public, and before the next scheduled information events (Target Q2 8-K accepted 2023-08-16 06:50 ET; July FOMC minutes released 2023-08-16 14:00 ET).

first_release_actual.source_quote: were $696.4 billion, up 0.7 percent (±0.5 percent) from the previous month, and up 3.2 percent (±0.7 percent) above July 2022

sources.publisher: FXStreet (pre-release preview of nine bank forecasts)
sources.published: 2023-08-14T13:45:32Z (article:published_time meta tag; i.e. before the release)
sources.quote: Retail Sales in the US are expected to rise 0.4% month-on-month vs. 0.2% in June.

sources.publisher: CNBC (post-release report citing the Dow Jones survey estimate)
sources.quote: The advanced retail sales report showed a seasonally adjusted increase of 0.7% for the month, better than the 0.4% Dow Jones estimate.

consensus.caveats: Consensus surveys (Dow Jones, Bloomberg, Reuters) are proprietary; we rely on public reports of them. The prior-month value (0.2%/0.3%) was NOT used as a consensus proxy. Consensus articles are used only for event metadata and are deliberately NOT part of the retrieval corpus (they are news, not primary documents).

surprise.definition: first-release actual minus public consensus (0.7 - 0.4), in percentage points; unstandardised (no forecast-dispersion data available)

hindsight_disclosure: The project author (an LLM coding agent) and the LLM assessor have general training-data knowledge of post-August-2023 markets. The graph was written from textbook theory before any return series was examined; no return data is downloaded or used anywhere in this project.
